_doc: Ordered list of TS derivers executed by 2_configs/build.sh derive. Runs after consolidate; order matters when a later deriver consumes an earlier one's output. Adding a deriver = append a JSON entry; build.sh remains untouched (fire-rule 6: data-driven, never hardcoded).

derivers.name: config-derive
derivers.description: Per-consumer JSON files (build-*.json + cloud-data-*.json archive) from _cloud-data-consolidated.json

derivers.name: mesh-snapshot
derivers.description: WireGuard mesh + wstunnel TCP/443 fallback snapshot consumed by bb-net_wireguard-mesh panel as PORTAL_DATA[mesh]

derivers.name: build-workflows
derivers.description: Runner-image registry (runners + probe + dispatch) extracted from 1_workflows/build.json. Replaces legacy cloud-data-runners.json. Consumed by 1_workflows/src/scripts/cloud-ship-* and tests via symlink 1_workflows/src/build-workflows.json -> ../../2_configs/dist/build-workflows.json
